tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bzhugs so:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs: longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bdag gi bla ma ngo mtshar sprul pa'i sku: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs thos bsam mdzad: bod yul dbus su zhal byon dregs pa btul: o rgyan yul du sku bzhugs 'gro don mdzad: sku yi ngo mtshar mthong ba'i tshe: g.yas pas ral gri'i phyag rgya mdzad: g.yon pas 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad: zhal bgrad mche gtsigs gyen la gzigs: rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'gro ba'i mgon: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas bdag sogs lam sna drongs: dgongs pas bdag la dngos grub stsol: nus pas bdag sogs bar chad sol: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol: nang gi bar chad nang du sol: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: dam chos rin chen gsan pa'i tshe: sku gsal 'od zer mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas phur pa'i po ti bsnams: zab mo'i chos rnams thugs su chud: yang le shod kyi paṇḍi ta: thugs rjes bdag= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: dam can dam la btags pa'i tshe: dri med gnas mchog nyams re dga': rgya gar bod yul sa mtshams su: byin gyis brlabs nas byon pa'i tshe: dri bsung spos ngad ldan pa'i ri: me tog padma dgun yang skyes: chu mig byang chub bdud rtsi'i chu: bde ldan de yi gnas mchog tu: skyes mchog tshul bzang chos gos gsol: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams: g.yon pas rin chen za ma tog: rakta bdud rtsis nang du gtams: mkha' 'gro dam can dam la btags: yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas=

phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= rgyal ba'i bstan pa btsugs pa'i tshe: g.ya' ri'i nags la sgrub pa mdzad: bsnyen phur nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phar: rdo rje'i phyag rgyas blangs shing bsgril: bsgril zhing tsandan nags su 'phangs: me 'bar 'khrugs shing mtsho yang skems: srib kyi mu stegs sa gang bsregs: yaksha nag po rdul du brlags: 'gran gyi do med bdud kyi gshed: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pa'i tshe: khye'u chung sprul pa'i cha lugs can: ya mtshan gzugs bzang kha dog legs: tshems 'grigs dbu skra ser la mdzes: dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: rin chen rgyan cha sna tshogs gsol: phyag g.yas 'khar ba'i phur pa bsnams: bdud dang srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsnams: mos pa'i bu la srung skyob mdzad: mgul na lcags kyi phur pa bsnams: yi dam lha dang gnyis su med: gnyis med sprul sku 'dzam gling rgyan: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= 'dre yi yul du dgongs pa'i tshe: me dpung shod kyi sa gzhi la: mda' rgyang gang gi mtsho nang du: padma'i steng du bsil bsil 'dra: padma'i nang na dgongs pa mdzad: mtshan yang padma 'byung gnas zhes: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su byon: de 'dra'i sprul sku ya mtshan can: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= bod kyi nyi ma mdzad pa'i tshe: dad ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa: gtsang kha la yi la thog tu: dgra lha'i dge bsnyen dam la btags: yul ni tsha ba'i tsha shod du: lha yi dge bsnyen dregs pa can: nyi shu rtsa gcig dam la btags: mang yul de yi byams sprin du: dge slong bzhi la dngos grub gnang:

khyad par 'phags pa'i rig 'dzin mchog: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= dpal mo thang gi dpal thang du: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: bod yul kha la'i la thog tu: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: 'dam shod lha bu'i snying drung du: thang lha yar bzhud dam la btags: che ba'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis: la las srog gi snying po phul: la las bstan pa bsrung bar byas: la las bran du khas blangs byas: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= dam pa chos kyi bstan pa ni: rgyal mtshan lta bur btsugs pa'i tshe: bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub: rgyal po'i dgongs pa mthar phyin mdzad: skyes mchog gsum gyi mtshan yang gsol: gcig ni padma 'byung gnas zhes: gcig ni padma saṃ bha wa: gcig ni mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes: gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= bsam yas mchims phur sgrub pa mdzad: rkyen ngan zlog cing dngos grub gnang: rje blon thar pa'i lam la bkod: gdon gzugs bon gyi bstan pa bsnubs: chos sku dri med rin chen bstan: skal ldan sangs rgyas sa la bkod: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= de nas o rgyan yul du byon: da lta srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: mi las lhag gyur ya mtshan can: spyod pa rmad byung ngo mtshar che: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs po che: thugs rjes= brtse bas= dgongs pas= nus pas= phyi yi= nang gi= gsang ba'i= gus pas= oṃ āḥhūm̐= sku gsung thugs ldan 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal: sgrib pa kun spangs khams gsum sa ler mkhyen: dngos grub mchog brnyes bde chen mchog gi sku: byang chub sgrub la bar chad nges par sel:

thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: brtse bas bdag sogs lam sna drongs: dgongs pas bdag la dngos grub stsol: nus pas bdag sogs bar chad sol: phyi yi bar chad phyi ru sol: nang gi bar chad nang du sol: gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rang gi sgrub pa rang gis mdzad: rjes 'jug jo mo mtsho rgyal gyis: phyi rabs gang zag brgyud 'dzin rnams: bar chad sel phyir zhus pa yin: rjes 'jug gang zag brgyud 'dzin rnams: nyams su longs la gsol ba thobs: gsol ba lan gcig btab pas kyang: nyin zhag gcig gi bar chad sel: ci bsam 'grub par the tshom med: brgyud 'dzin skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sprul sku ba mkhal smug pos spyan drangs pa'o/// /
